generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
EMD RS. 45000.00 Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

The Tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Certificate/Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive).

The Tenderer shall scan the Original Ownership Documents/ Lease/ Hire commitment Agreement for the Machinery and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
The defect liability period for this work is 365 days
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal.
The rates of all the items appeared in Bill of Quantities are inclusive of all leads and lifts
The contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF rules and any modifications before and after execution of agreement
After the award of the contract, the contractor has to furnish the details in respect of labour employed and the EPF details for this work in every RA bill.
Bidders are advised to note that , 18% GST will be added to the contract amount.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
The bidder should mention the UDIN No. on the turnover certificate, failing which bid is rejected.
If the bidder uploaded the false document while participating in the tender, the bidder will be responsible and action will be initiated as per the tender clause.
The work should be completed in 03 Months (including monsoon)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26(a) achieved in at least TWO financial years an average financial turn over (in all cases of civil engineering construction works only) Rs. 17.82 Lakhs cases of civil engineering construction works only

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (b) satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least One Single Similar Nature of Work value not less than Rs. 8.91 Lakhs.
Verification of All past Experiences to be considered excluding GST

itemList.description: Applying  priming  coat:  With   ready   mixed   pink   or   Grey   primer   of approved  brand  and manufacture on wood work (hard and soft wood) including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting   with   synthetic   enamel   paint   of   approved   brand   and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade :Two coats on new work over an under coat of suitable shade with ordinary paint of approved brand and manufacture  after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing   Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular  hollow  tubes  etc.)  trusses  etc.,  including  cutting,  hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer, including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished seamless type tubes including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing, Laying and Fixing of GI pipes conforming to IS 1239:1990 with latest amendments complete with GI fittings (excluding the cost of fittings) with cuts and threads wherever necessary, including testing for water tightness, with all lead and commissioning. (contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) For Medium Duty GI pipe of  20mm dia

Providing and fixing good-quality seasoned bamboo chick mats including cutting, knitting, finishing and attaching kora white cloth with overlapping and stitching, Applying approved primer on bamboo mat and Painting with 2coat synthetic enamel paint of specified color for an even shade, Stitching 2" wide nylon nawar patty, Fixing nylon rope to chick mats, installing heavy-duty pulleys with rollers and teak wood guttas with 6" long hooks, drilling 4" deep into stone pillars using diamond-edge drilling bits, fixing 20mm dia galvanized/mild steel tubes to walls, ceilings and floors with fittings, thoroughly cleaning surfaces to remove oil, grease, dirt, and foreign matter, and covering including cost of all materials, labour charges, with all lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation charges and incidental charges, as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Providing and fixing Bamboo chick mats made out of 50% good quality seasoned bamboo cutting and finishing etc., complete with all lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation charges etc., complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Providing and stitching white cloth for chick mat including cutting to the required sahpe and stitching and over lapping and stitching the same to chick mat etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing and fixing nylon rope to chick mats with all lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation charges etc., complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
Providing and fixing heavy duty Pulley with necessary rollers and suitable arrangements etc., complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work
Providing and fixing of Teak wood guttas with 6" long hooks etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Drilling to the stone pillar to a depth of 4" with diamond edge drilling bit using high speed hammer drilling machine etc., complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing and fixing "L" shape clamp and drilling the same to hold end bays mat and also rectgangular box etc., complete including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour for all items of work, all lead and lift, loading and unloading and all other incidental charges etc., complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Providing stitching nylon Nawar patty as per specifiation 2" width made out of nylon threads etc., complete with all lead and lift, loading and unloadig, transportation chages etc., complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Painting and fixing 'L' shape flat to hold rectangular tubular box including drilling and fixing necessary bolts, including providing and removing necessary scaffolding etc., complete including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour for all items of work, all lead and lift, loading and unloading and all other incidentalc ahrges etc., complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
